text:
alex: Heads-up: promotion pipeline to eu-west failing SBOM verification for builder-image:v2026-03-17. Registry digest mismatch across regions.

maya: saw the alert. build job shows different manifest digests in gcr vs ecr-eu. looks like cross-region mirror didn't preserve manifest annotations (SBOM blob ref).

dhruv: build logs: `publish: push manifest list -> OK` then `promote: mirror to eu -> OK` but cosign verify on eu registry fails with `sbom not found` during downstream CI job.

buildbot: [CI] job infra/builder/publish#102 failed: SBOM_CHECK_FAILED (exit 21)

lia: did we change the baker's cache/ttl or the bakery-builder workflow? last successful run had cosign sig and SBOM blob uploaded to artifact-store.

alex: we bumped bakery cache TTL last week to reduce rebuild frequency. might be hiding a race where the SBOM upload to blobstore happens after the registry manifest gets pushed (race condition).

maya: reproduction steps I ran:
```
# build and push
make builder-image && ./ci/publish --tag v2026-03-17
# check manifests
skopeo inspect docker://eu.gcr.io/redwood/builder-image:v2026-03-17
skopeo inspect docker://gcr.io/redwood/builder-image@sha256:...
```

skopeo output shows different manifest lists and missing "sbom" artifact descriptor in eu copy.

dhruv: cause theory: our promotion job uses registry-to-registry copy (crane/skopeo) which may not copy non-container artifacts (SBOM blobs) unless we explicitly copy the descriptor refs. also multi-arch manifest lists can get rewritten by registries.

alex: action items proposed: 1) require cosign+sbom presence before promoting; 2) change promotion to push artifacts from source rather than rely on registry mirror; 3) add a quick post-promote verification job that fetches SBOM by digest and validates signature.

lia: also we should pin image digests in terraform/helm templates instead of tags for Dedicated infra tooling. Helm values currently have `image: redwood/builder-image:latest` in infra charts. That's contributing to env drift.

maya: agreed. PR incoming to change chart values to accept `image.digest` and update our GitOps generator to render digests from the release pipeline.

dhruv: quick patch for CI to fail fast: in infra/builder/publish step add:
```
# verify SBOM artifact exists in registry source
curl -f $SBOM_URL || (echo "SBOM missing" && exit 1)
# verify cosign
cosign verify -key $COSIGN_KEY $IMAGE_REF
```

buildbot: [CI] created issue infra#456: "builder promotion preserves SBOM and signature across regions" assigned to @dhruv

lia: one more thing — Terraform module infra/docker-image uses remote data to fetch digest via registry API. If the registry returns different digests per region due to mirrored manifests, the module ends up generating different terraform plans between regions. We should make the registry-of-record the canonical source (us-central) and propagate digests from publish pipeline.

alex: yes, canonical source from central publish job. we should store a canonical mapping in artifact metadata service: {tag -> digest, sbom-location, cosign-sig}. gitops can read that mapping during PR generation.

maya: regarding SBOM formats — current SBOM is SPDX JSON. some registries store it as OCI artifact type `application/spdx+json` and some as blob with custom media type. We need to standardize on an OCI artifact type that cosign + our sbom-checker expect.

dhruv: propose we adopt `application/vnd.redwood.sbom.v1+json` and document it in builder readme + add validation. Will migrate old artifacts via a migration job that re-uploads SBOMs and signs them.

lia: cost angle: mirroring whole artifacts across regions increases egress & storage. if we force publish-from-source we double egress. maybe we should push manifests only and rely on on-demand retrieval of SBOMs from canonical blobstore (S3) referenced by manifest annotations. cheaper but more network hops at deploy time.

alex: tradeoff table:
- mirror everything: higher storage/egress, faster local pulls, consistent offline behavior
- central SBOM store with manifest link: lower storage, want to ensure registry/mirroring won't drop links
We need an SLO for SBOM availability.

maya: shorter-term fix: update publish pipeline to copy SBOM blob explicitly with `oras cp` and include cosign signature. long-term: canonical metadata service + reduce mirrors as needed.

dhruv: I'm going to open a small PR to builder/publish to call `oras copy --include=artifact` and then run `cosign sign-blob` for SBOM blob before final manifest push.

buildbot: [CI] infra/builder/publish#103 started by dhruv

lia: I'll start a tiny terraform change to make helm image value prefer digest env var and add a fallback to tag (for dev). will open PR to infra-helm-values.

alex: assigning owners: dhruv for publish pipeline change, maya for helm/generator rendering to use digest, lia for terraform/helm drift guard. target: patch rollout by EOD tomorrow, verification job added to CI then enable strict SBOM gate in 2 days.

dhruv: noted. will post PR link when ready.

maya: thanks — can someone add this to the incident log? want to track root cause and follow-up.

sre-bot: incident logged: INC-2026-0323-7 "SBOM missing after regional promotion". status: triage.

alex: cool. if anyone hits weird Terraform diffs after this, ping me. I'll coordinate a small tf apply lock window for infra charts. :thumbsup:

lia: quick note — also audit our image promotion metric in datadog: `registry.promotion.sbom_mismatch` to alert if >0 for 15m.

buildbot: [CI] infra/builder/publish#103 passed the SBOM copy tests on staging. :rocket:

maya: great — merging the helm values PR now.

alex: wrap-up: short-term: explicit SBOM copy + cosign sign blob + post-promote verification. medium: canonical metadata service + pin digests in helm/terraform. long: evaluate mirror policy for cost/perf.

dhruv: will follow-up with PRs and a short runbook for on-call if promotion fails.

lia: thanks everyone.

maya: :eyes:

alex: :shipit:
